 Selfridges opens permanent Biodance and Medicube counters in new K-Beauty destination 
 Sophie Smith 02 November 2026 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Linkedin 
 WhatsApp 
 Selfridges has expanded its K-beauty offering with permanent counters for Biodance and Medicube at its Oxford Street flagship, bringing the two brands together in a shared retail space for the first time. 
 The opening marks Biodance’s first permanent retail counter worldwide and Medicube’s first in Europe, representing a significant step in both brands’ UK retail expansion as demand for Korean skincare continues to grow.
 Located within a new dedicated K-beauty destination in The Beauty Workshop, in the Ground Floor North Central Beauty Hall, the counters sit alongside brands including Beauty of Joseon, SKIN1004, Axis-Y, Thank You Farmer, VT Cosmetics and Dr. Reju-All.
 According to Luneia Brands, the distributor behind the launch, the counters are intended to provide customers with opportunities to explore the brands' products through demonstrations, consultations and in-person experiences.
 Both spaces feature the brands' largest physical product ranges currently available in the UK. Medicube's counter also includes a dedicated facial device area showcasing its AGE-R technology, including the AGE-R Booster Pro, alongside personalised skincare consultations.
 Meanwhile, Biodance, best known for its Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask, will offer product demonstrations, sampling and consultations across its wider skincare range. Further product launches are planned throughout 2027.
 The openings come as both brands continue to expand their international presence. According to parent company APR, Medicube's AGE-R beauty devices have surpassed six million sales globally, while Biodance reports worldwide sales of more than 350 million hydrogel masks.
 Both brands have also recorded significant sales growth in the UK. Medicube's Zero Pore Pad 2.0 and Biodance's Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask featured in Lookfantastic's top 10 skincare products of 2026 so far , with year-on-year sales value increases of 919.9% and 331.5%, respectively.
 To mark the launch, Biodance will host a series of in-store activations and gifting experiences throughout November, including a launch-day Lucky Dip and limited-edition beauty goody bags. Medicube will also offer complimentary smoothies from Selfridges' Elevate bar to customers spending £50 or more between 4 and 10 November, subject to availability.
